# Recorded Woo expansion samples

`accepted-samples.json` contains 45 public merchant observations from 2026-09-08. Each sample preserves the observed merchant URL, price, selected dimensions and image origins. For 25 parent objects, `variations` is reduced to the descriptor for the recorded child; other saved fields and the retained descriptor match their source record. These are bounded contract fixtures, not byte-identical full response bodies or current price guarantees.

The [review ledger](../../../../../docs/engineering/changes/2026-09-08-woocommerce-expansion-evidence.json) records the full local raw-file SHA-256, read times, positive/negative search and lookup evidence, and independent controller samples. Reader and controller samples may identify different products returned for the same keyword; their prices and IDs must not be combined.
